accessibility.seat-link-qr: QR code of the seat link

description.add-account: With an account, by its exact username: the results belong to that account.
description.add-guest: Without an account, by name only.
description.cancel-tournament: “{{name}}” will be cancelled. The rounds played so far stay visible.
description.change-deck: Private decks are not offered. Once the tournament is running, the chosen deck is registered as a copy at once and gets a checkpoint.
description.co-organizers: Co-organizers do everything you do, except deleting the tournament, removing co-organizers and handing it on.
description.delete-tournament: "{{name}}" and everything in it will be deleted for good.
description.drop-participant: {{name}} will not be paired from the next round on. The results so far stay in the standings. This cannot be undone.
description.drop-self: You will not be paired from the next round on. Your results so far stay in the standings. This cannot be undone.
description.enter-rounds: Enter each round as it was played: enter the pairings, start the round, enter the results, end the round.
description.entered-afterwards: For a tournament already played on paper: the date may lie in the past, organizers enter every pairing and result themselves, players report nothing.
description.entered-afterwards-locked: Fixed once the first round started.
description.entry-fee: Leave empty if taking part is free. With an entry fee, only Participants an Organizer marked paid are paired.
description.entry-fee-locked: Once the first Round started, no entry fee can be introduced.
description.final-draw: A drawn final goes to whoever finished best in the Swiss rounds. Whoever drops during the final loses it.
description.format: Leave empty when any format is allowed.
description.handover: Nothing changes until they accept. You then stay on as a co-organizer.
description.handover-pending: Offered to {{username}}. Nothing changes until they accept.
description.late-participant: Players added now join from the next round, with no match points.
description.leave-tournament: You will no longer run "{{name}}". Only the owner can add you again.
description.my-bye: You have a bye this round and do not play.
description.my-deck-closed: The first round has started; only the organizers can change your deck now.
description.my-deck-follows: Until the first round starts, your deck counts as it is then, so changes until then are in.
description.my-deck-late: The tournament is already running: the deck you register now counts as it is at this moment, and you cannot swap it afterwards.
description.my-deck-pinned: Since the first round started you play a copy of your deck that no longer changes with it. A checkpoint in the deck history marks that version.
description.no-my-tournaments: Create a tournament to find it here again.
description.no-organizing: You do not organize any tournament yet.
description.no-own-decks: You have no decks to register yet.
description.no-participating: You do not play in any tournament yet.
description.no-player-decks: This account has no public decks and none shared by link.
description.no-public-tournaments: As soon as someone creates a public tournament, it shows up here.
description.no-top-cut: This tournament has no top cut.
description.not-visible: This tournament does not exist, or you may not see it.
description.organizers-only: Only the owner and the co-organizers of this tournament see who runs it.
description.pairing-swap-hint: Tap two players to swap their places; that also hands on the bye.
description.participant-limit: Leave empty for no limit. Holds back self sign-up only; organizers can still add players beyond it.
description.report-result: Your result counts at once. The players at your table can dispute it until the round ends.
description.report-winner: Who won the game at your table, or a draw for everyone. It counts at once; the players at your table can dispute it until the round ends.
description.reset-timer: The round timer starts again at {{time}}.
description.round-minutes: Minutes per round. The timer runs from the start of every round; leave empty for no timer.
description.round-preview: Only organizers see these pairings until the round starts.
description.ruleset-mtr: Magic Tournament Rules: a win is 3, a draw 1, a loss 0, a bye counts as 2-0.
description.ruleset-multiplayer-addendum: Multiplayer Addendum: a win is twice the table size minus one (7 at tables of four), a draw 1, a loss 0, smaller tables instead of byes.
description.ruleset-top-deck: TopDeck: a win is 5, a draw 1, a loss 0, at most one smaller table, then byes.
description.self-sign-up: Players with an account sign up themselves until the first round starts.
description.self-sign-up-private: Only for public tournaments and tournaments by link.
description.set-result: Games won by each player; corrections are possible at any time.
description.set-winner: Who won the game, or a draw for everyone; corrections are possible at any time.
description.share-link: Anyone with this link sees the tournament.
description.share-link-dead: The link was withdrawn or the tournament deleted.
description.share-list: Once the tournament is finished, everybody sees your list next to the standings. Before that nobody but the organizers sees it.
description.share-list-fixed: The tournament is over, so your choice is fixed.
description.swiss-rounds-follow-suggestion: Follows the suggestion until you set a number or the first round starts.
description.swiss-rounds-unknown: The number of rounds is not set yet.
description.take-back-round: The round runs again and keeps its results. A next round already paired is discarded.
description.tiebreaker-gw: GW%: the share of games won.
description.tiebreaker-mw: MW%: the own share of matches won, match points over the most possible.
description.tiebreaker-oamp: OAMP: the opponents' average match points; an empty seat at a smaller table counts as an opponent without points.
description.tiebreaker-ogw: OGW%: the opponents' average share of games won.
description.tiebreaker-omw: OMW%: how strong the opponents were, their average share of matches won.
description.tiebreaker-owr: OWR: how strong the opponents were, their average win rate; a bye counts as a table of opponents at 20%.
description.tiebreaker-wr: WR: the own win rate, match points over the most possible, at least 20%.
description.tiebreakers: Equal match points are decided by the tiebreakers, from left to right.
description.time-up-mtr_one: The active player finishes their turn, then {{count}} more turn is played in total. A game still undecided after that is a draw.
description.time-up-mtr_other: The active player finishes their turn, then {{count}} more turns are played in total. A game still undecided after them is a draw.
description.time-up-multiplayer-addendum: No extra turns: the active player finishes their turn. Without a winner by then, the match is a draw.
description.time-up-top-deck: No extra turns: the game ends when the active player finishes their turn, at the latest 20 minutes after time is up.
description.top-cut: After the Swiss rounds the best play on in single elimination, seeded by the standings: 1 against 8, 4 against 5, 2 against 7, 3 against 6. Changeable until the Swiss rounds are over.
description.top-cut-final: After the Swiss rounds the best play one final at a single table, seated by the standings, the best first. Changeable until the Swiss rounds are over.
description.top-cut-locked: The Swiss rounds are over, the top cut is fixed.
description.top-cut-size_one: Then the best {{count}} play the top cut.
description.top-cut-size_other: Then the best {{count}} play the top cut.
description.unpaid-count_one: {{count}} Participant has not paid yet and is not paired.
description.unpaid-count_other: {{count}} Participants have not paid yet and are not paired.
description.visibility-private: Only you, your co-organizers and the players see the tournament.
description.visibility-public: Anyone finds the tournament in the overview.
description.visibility-unlisted: Anyone with the link sees the tournament.
description.organizer-view: Manage Rounds, Results and Participants through the Tournament sections.
description.preparing-to-play: You are signed up. Check your Registered deck while waiting for the first Round.
description.participation-cancelled: The Tournament was cancelled. Recorded Results remain available.
description.participation-finished: The Tournament has finished. You can review Results and Standings.
description.waiting-for-match: You have no Match in this Round. Check the Participants or ask an Organizer.
description.waiting-for-round: Wait for an Organizer to start the next Round. Results and Standings remain available.
description.play-and-report: Play your Match, then report the Result.
description.format-defaults: The format suggests a table size and ruleset. Valid manual choices are preserved. Changing the table size adjusts incompatible rulesets and top cuts.
description.tournament-push-activation: Get pairings and other tournament updates so you do not miss them. Activation is optional.
description.tournament-push-enabled: Tournament notifications are enabled for this device and your account.
description.tournament-push-unavailable: Notifications are unavailable here. On iPhone and iPad, open the app added to your Home Screen. You can keep participating without notifications.
description.tournament-push-denied: Your browser has not allowed notifications. Allow them in browser settings and reload this page. Your tournament participation is unaffected.
description.tournament-push-global-disabled: Tournament notifications are turned off for your account. Activation turns them back on for all tournaments on your subscribed devices.
description.review-life-result: Review the suggestion from explicitly ended Games. Only saving submits the Tournament Result.
description.life-history-observer: This device observes the saved history. Only the explicitly selected recording device can change it.
description.life-history-empty: No history has been uploaded for this match yet. You can play and report results without recording.
description.life-transferring: Counting is paused while all changes are saved. The new device can then start recording. Retry if the connection fails.
description.life-transfer-instructions: If the previous device is available, choose Transfer recording there. Wait until every change is saved, then start recording here.
description.life-confirm-unavailable: Confirm that the previous device is unavailable and you want to continue from this saved state. Changes that have not uploaded remain only on the previous device. Its later-returning changes are preserved separately.
description.life-conflict-captured: All recovered changes from this device are saved as a separate server history. The active timeline is unchanged.
description.life-conflict-local: Unsent changes remain on this device. Retry to save them as a separate history.
description.life-branch-independent: This history is separate from active recording. It changes neither the active device’s totals nor the Tournament Result.
description.life-takeover-changed: The saved state changed. Review it again before confirming takeover.
description.life-history-tab-lock-unavailable: This browser cannot safely coordinate recording tabs. You can view saved history and still report Results.
description.create-tournament: Set up a tournament in three steps. Everything can still be changed until the first round starts.
description.not-checked-in-count_one: {{count}} participant is not checked in yet.
description.not-checked-in-count_other: {{count}} participants are not checked in yet.
description.check-in-needs-deck: You need a registered deck to check in.
description.keep-guest-seat: Keep this seat with your account.

error.all-rounds-paired: Every Swiss round has been paired.
error.best-of-mismatch: Best of applies to two players at a table only, and there it must be chosen.
error.co-organizer-already: This account is a co-organizer already.
error.cut-size: The top cut seats as many players as its size says.
error.drop-not-started: The first round has not started yet.
error.dropped-winner: A player who dropped cannot win the final.
error.entry-fee-invalid: Enter an amount above zero, e.g. 5 or 5.50.
error.entry-fee-locked: Once the first Round started, the entry fee cannot be removed.
error.invalid-layout: Every player must sit exactly once, at a table of the right size.
error.invalid-score: This score does not fit the match format.
error.later-round-started: A later round has already started.
error.no-round-timer: This round runs without a round timer.
error.no-entry-fee: The Tournament has no entry fee.
error.not-their-deck: This deck does not belong to the player's account.
error.participant-limit-too-small: A tournament needs at least 2 players.
error.result-disputed: The result is disputed; an organizer settles it.
error.result-missing: There is no result to dispute yet.
error.result-own-report: You reported this result yourself. Report it again to correct it.
error.result-reported-by-other: A different result was reported already. Dispute it if it is wrong.
error.results-disputed: A result is disputed. Settle it before the round ends.
error.round-changed: The round has changed in the meantime.
error.round-minutes-out-of-range: The round timer runs from 1 to 240 minutes.
error.round-not-running: The round is no longer running.
error.round-not-started: The round has not started yet.
error.rules-locked: Table size, ruleset and best of are fixed since the first round.
error.ruleset-mismatch: This ruleset does not fit the table size.
error.self-sign-up-needs-visibility: Nobody else sees a private tournament, so nobody can sign up for it.
error.share-list-fixed: The tournament is over, so your choice can no longer be changed.
error.swiss-rounds-out-of-range: At least as many rounds as already paired, at most 30.
error.too-few-participants: A round needs at least 2 players.
error.too-many-unknown: Too many unknown names. Try again later.
error.too-many-unknown-usernames: Too many unknown usernames. Try again later.
error.top-cut-best-of-mismatch: Choose the match length of the top cut.
error.top-cut-locked: The Swiss rounds are over, the top cut can no longer change.
error.top-cut-mismatch: Top 4 and top 8 need 2 players at a table, a final needs more.
error.unknown-username: No account goes by this username.
error.load-participation: Your participation could not be loaded.
error.tournament-push-activation: Notifications could not be enabled or checked. Try again. Your tournament participation is unaffected.
error.life-history-save: History could not be loaded or saved on the server. Your local changes remain on this device.
error.life-history-conflict: Recording ownership or saved history has changed. Your local changes are retained and do not replace the server history.
error.life-history-invalid: This history cannot be saved. It may be too large or contain an unsupported change. Locally recorded games remain on this device.
error.life-history-storage: Browser storage is unavailable. New changes exist only in this open window. Free some space and try again.
error.life-history-auth: Sign in again with the Account that recorded this Match. Local changes remain retained.
error.life-handover-network: The saved state could not be confirmed. Check the connection and retry.
error.check-in-needs-deck: No check-in without a registered deck.
error.check-out-started: Check-in can no longer be undone once the first round started.
error.check-in-dropped: A participant who dropped can no longer be checked in or out.
error.check-in-deck-for-limited: Draft and Sealed have no check-in with deck.
error.guest-sign-up-busy: Too many sign-ups, try again in a moment.
error.guest-sign-up-failed: Signing up isn't possible right now.
error.seat-link-unknown: This seat link no longer works.
error.seat-link-failed: The seat link couldn't be used right now.
error.seat-link-not-a-guest: Players with an account log in.
error.claim-no-seat: This device holds no guest seat.
